description: Monique DeSpain, the Republican candidate for Oregon's 4th Congressional District, today released her first television advertisement of the general election, using it to draw a direct line between Val Hoyle’s continued political corruption, her biggest corporate supporters and the tax breaks fueling Oregon's data center boom.
